title: Successful login with valid credentials
description: Verify that users can log in successfully using valid credentials through Supabase Auth and are redirected appropriately based on their role.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter valid username/email and password
Click on the login button
User is authenticated and redirected based on role with access to permitted routes

title: Prevent login with invalid credentials
description: Ensure login fails when users provide incorrect username/email or password and that appropriate error messages are displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter invalid username/email or password
Click on the login button
Login is rejected and error message about invalid credentials is shown

title: Role-based route protection enforcement
description: Confirm users cannot access routes outside their role permissions and that unauthorized access is blocked.

steps.description: Login as a user with restricted role
Attempt to navigate directly to a route not permitted for this role
Route access is denied and user is redirected to an error or home page

title: Multi-tenant data isolation between establishments
description: Validate that users only see data for establishments assigned within their company context and no access to other entities' data.

steps.description: Login as user assigned to Establishment A
Attempt to view data related to Establishment B
Data from Establishment B is not visible and errors or empty states are shown

title: Create reservation with valid availability and client data
description: Verify users can create reservations when the selected room is available, dates are valid, and client info is complete and validated.

steps.description: Navigate to reservation creation form
Select valid date range within availability
Select an available room
Enter valid client information
Submit reservation form
Reservation is successfully created and reflected on calendar and occupancy map with correct pricing

title: Reservation creation fails with invalid date ranges
description: Ensure validation prevents reservation creation when end date is before start date or dates are in the past.

steps.description: Open reservation creation form
Input an end date earlier than start date
Attempt to submit the form
Validation error is displayed and form cannot be submitted

title: Reservation creation blocked when room unavailable
description: Verify that users cannot create a reservation for a room that is already reserved or marked unavailable in the selected date range.

steps.description: Select a room that is already booked in the desired date range
Attempt to create a reservation for that date range
System shows error about room unavailability and prevents submission

title: Dynamic pricing calculation with seasons and promotions
description: Check that the reservation pricing dynamically updates based on date changes, season pricing plans, and applicable promotions matching backend logic.

steps.description: Create or edit a reservation
Change reservation dates to fall under different pricing seasons
Pricing is recalculated accordingly and displayed to user
Apply valid promotion codes
Pricing reflects discounts from promotions correctly

title: Edit and cancel reservation workflows
description: Validate users can successfully edit and cancel existing reservations, and changes reflect immediately on calendars and occupancy maps.

steps.description: Open existing reservation details
Modify reservation details such as dates, room, or client info
Save changes and verify updates on calendar
Cancel the reservation
Reservation status updated to cancelled, removed from active calendar and occupancy views

title: Maintenance ticket creation and room status integration
description: Ensure maintenance tickets can be created, assigned with priority and status changes update corresponding room status preventing new reservations for that room if applicable.

steps.description: Create a maintenance ticket for a specific room
Assign priority and technician
Change maintenance ticket status to 'in progress'
Room status updates to unavailable and blocks new reservations

title: Maintenance ticket prevents conflicting reservations
description: Validate that rooms under active maintenance tickets cannot be reserved until maintenance is resolved or status change permits availability.

steps.description: Log maintenance ticket with status active on a room
Attempt to create a reservation for that room during the maintenance period
System disallows reservation and displays appropriate message

title: Channel manager OTA data synchronization
description: Test that availability and pricing data synchronize correctly between the system and connected OTAs (Booking, Airbnb, Expedia), ensuring data consistency and imports of reservations function as expected.

steps.description: Configure OTA channel with valid credentials
Trigger manual synchronization
Availability and pricing data on OTA and system match after sync
Import new reservations from OTA
Imported reservations appear correctly in the reservation system with appropriate statuses

title: Financial reports display accurate aggregated data
description: Verify financial reports show correct revenue, payment methods, cash flow, and channel comparisons with interactive charts matching data fetched from Supabase backend.

steps.description: Navigate to financial reports dashboard
Reports accurately reflect revenue, payment methods, and channel data consistent with backend
Export reports to supported formats
Exported reports match on-screen data and are properly formatted

title: User CRUD operations for client management
description: Ensure users can create, read, update, and delete client records including personal and document information correctly with validations.

steps.description: Create a new client with valid personal and document data
Client is saved and visible in client list
Edit client information and save changes
Changes are reflected correctly without data loss
Delete a client record
Client is removed from the system and list updated

title: Room inventory management with status updates
description: Verify managing room details including categories, buildings, status updates, and availability functions correctly reflecting in usage and booking capabilities.

steps.description: Create a new room category and assign it to a room
Update room status to maintenance or unavailable
Room status updated and availability on calendars reflects status changes

title: Dashboard displays real-time occupancy and reservation data
description: Confirm dashboard shows up-to-date occupancy metrics, recent reservation info, and financial summaries consistent with system data.

steps.description: Login and navigate to main dashboard
Occupancy charts and metrics correspond to current reservations and room statuses
Financial summaries show correct aggregated data

title: User profile updates with validation and authentication
description: Validate that users can update personal data, change email and password securely with necessary validations and confirmation mechanisms.

steps.description: Navigate to user profile page
Modify personal information fields with valid data
Change email and/or password with correct current password verification
Updates are saved successfully, and changes are reflected on next login

title: Role-based user and employee management flows
description: Ensure admins can add, edit, and remove employees with proper role assignments and that corresponding access control is enforced.

steps.description: As admin, create a new employee user and assign roles
New user can log in and access permitted features only
Modify roles of existing employees
Access restrictions apply immediately according to updated roles
Delete an employee user
Deleted user no longer has access and data is removed or archived appropriately

title: Error handling and loading state presence
description: Verify consistent display of loading indicators and error messages across all major features including reservations, financial reports, and channel management.

steps.description: Trigger features requiring data loads, e.g., open reservations or financial reports with slow network
Loading spinners or placeholders are shown during data fetching
Simulate backend errors or network failures
Appropriate error messages and recovery options are displayed to the user

title: Settings module hotel and API integration updates
description: Test that hotel information, schedules, payment methods, and API integration settings can be modified correctly and persist across sessions.

steps.description: Navigate to settings page
Update hotel information and save
Modify API integration credentials and test connection
Changes are saved and persist after page reload with successful API connection test
